symptom: Landscape #205 failed because newly added error-control validation records used effective_status/validated_at while the canonical loader requires status/observed_at.
root_cause: The new validation artifacts were authored from a conceptual effective-state vocabulary instead of first inspecting the canonical VAL-* contract consumed by error_control_audit.py.
early_signals: Existing VAL-ERR-031.json uses status and observed_at
error_control_audit.py rejects validation records whose status is absent or unsupported
Landscape #205 reported unsupported validation status: None
human_cost: No user intervention required; CI detected the mismatch automatically.
prevention_rule: Before adding a governed artifact family member, inspect at least one canonical sibling and the consuming loader/schema; validation records must conform to the existing contract.
automated_detection: Landscape Intelligence Schema error-control audit tests.
